name: Torrevieja (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided light blue over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Torrevieja (a crowned shield with a tower on a rock by the sea beneath the Senyera).
history: Municipal flag of Torrevieja; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Torrevieja arms — tower on a rock by the sea
